result.notes: Screenshots verified: ws5_top (hero blue-hour parallax), ws5_mid (Projects execution cards), ws5_bottom (Contact Signal + CTA + real links), ws5_rm_hero (reduced-motion static hero, full content), ws5_rm_about (reduced-motion About with stat figures 3+/5/2). 3D model absent headless (SwiftShader->SVG fallback) = expected. PERF RECOMMENDATION (not actioned, do not touch files): the 9 PNGs are 7000x2076 -> decode to ~58MB RGBA each (~520MB texture footprint across layers) despite tiny on-disk size; recommend offline pre-scaling sources to ~3000-3500px wide to cut decode memory ~4x on low-RAM devices.
result.summary: WS5 perf + reduced-motion + final polish. PERF: hero PNGs ~108-382KB on disk (~2MB total), only parallax0 eager/high-priority, rest lazy; will-change:transform correctly placed on rAF layers only. ONE WEBGL CANVAS: verified portfolio:bg-pause wiring intact (ShowcaseSection IntersectionObserver dispatches; _Scene.tsx flips frameloop to 'never' + Page Visibility; resumes on exit). REDUCED-MOTION+TOUCH: all guards verified - Hero static first frame; Projects pin matchMedia-gated (>=768px + no-preference) with stacked fallback; Traveler/3D gated to SvgCoreFallback via SceneContainer; WS4 reveals visible end-states. FIXED projects edge case: added MIN_PIN_TRAVEL=80px guard so a near-zero horizontal distance skips the pin (clears entrance props, normal flow). CONSOLE: zero pageerrors + zero console errors in normal AND reduced-motion passes. Bonus: reduced-motion About count-up now writes real figures (3+/5/2) instead of 0 placeholders. tsc clean.
